caption: Test pooled observed-entry root mean squared error (RMSE) at the 12-hour horizon versus training cap, in cohort-A training standard-deviation units. Lines show the arithmetic mean of four per-run pooled RMSEs; whiskers are pointwise 95% Student t intervals over the four training seeds (3 degrees of freedom), not intervals for pairwise model differences. Outer rings mark each family's cap selected by minimum mean cohort-A validation RMSE across the four seeds (exact ties choose the smaller cap): Shared no edges, 105 epochs, Shared admissible, 70 epochs, GRU-D, 35 epochs. The cap also sets the cosine learning-rate schedule period; these cap-specific fits do not isolate training duration. Checkpoints within each fit are validation-selected. A/B test scores do not enter cap selection, but were already available before the retrospective selection analysis. Intervals describe training-seed variation conditional on fixed cohorts, do not estimate patient or hospital sampling uncertainty, and are unadjusted for multiple comparisons.

provenance_format: value_ids link each plotted numeric coordinate to values. Direct nodes give an repository-relative source_file, JSON Pointer source_field, source_sha256 and unrounded value. Arithmetic nodes give their operation and input value IDs; they are necessary because the original historical-experiment summary rounds aggregate statistics. Layout coordinates, ticks, padding and categorical row positions are display settings, not observations.
input_note: historical-experiment shared_edges contrasts use historical historical-experiment runs and are not plotted. historical-experiment supplies the MDD planning multiplier only; historical-experiment supplies current historical-experiment MDDs.
